model.sample_weight: 1 / number of baskets sharing the crossing date

calibration.method: expanding weighted empirical CDF of raw model score
calibration.holdout_update: scores from a holdout crossing date enter calibration history only after that date; no holdout labels are used

frozen_engine.initial_exposure: STEP06K breadth softening: 87.5% if accel_rankmean > 0.50 else 75%

holdout_data_rule: DGS10 is sourced from the official FRED DGS10 table; dgs10_chg63 is current DGS10 minus DGS10 63 frozen engine sessions earlier. No changes after replay.
promotion_rule: diagnostic only unless it improves the frozen DD frontier without an unacceptable CAGR concession; no post-holdout retuning
